mapper.select: SELECT A."ASSET_NO", A."STOCK_COUNT", A."STOCK_PURCHASE", A."USERNAME", S."STOCK_NO", S."STOCK_CODE", S."STOCK_NAME" FROM "ASSETS" A JOIN "STOCK" S ON A."ASSET_NO" = S."STOCK_CODE" WHERE A."USERNAME" = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "ORDER" ( "ORDER_ID", "ORDER_TYPE", "ORDER_PRICE", "ORDER_COUNT", "ORDER_DATE", "STOCK_NO", "STOCK_CODE", "USERNAME" ) VALUES ( DEFAULT, #{orderType}, #{orderPrice}, #{orderCount}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{stockNo}, #{stockCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{username} )
mapper.select: SELECT O."ORDER_ID", O."ORDER_TYPE", O."ORDER_PRICE", O."ORDER_COUNT", O."ORDER_DATE", O."STOCK_NO", O."STOCK_CODE", O."USERNAME", S."STOCK_NAME" FROM "ORDER" O JOIN "STOCK" S ON O."STOCK_NO" = S."STOCK_NO" WHERE O."USERNAME" = #{username} ORDER BY O."ORDER_DATE" DESC
